statement: ∀ (τ α s : ℝ) (g : ℝ → ℝ), 0 < τ → Continuous g → (∀ r ∈ Set.Icc 0 τ, ‖KdVPlan.phase α s - KdVPlan.phase α r‖ ≤ g r) → τ * ‖KdVPlan.phase α s - KdVPlan.avg τ (KdVPlan.phase α)‖ ≤ ∫ r in (0 : ℝ)..τ, g r
proof:
intro τ α s g hτ hg hbound
have heq : τ * ‖KdVPlan.phase α s - KdVPlan.avg τ (KdVPlan.phase α)‖ = ‖∫ r in (0 : ℝ)..τ, KdVPlan.phase α s - KdVPlan.phase α r‖ := by
  rw [yui_aux_0006 T gamma R τ (KdVPlan.phase α) s (ne_of_gt hτ) (yui_aux_0004 T gamma R α)]
  rw [norm_mul, norm_inv, Complex.norm_real, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_pos hτ]
  field_simp
rw [heq]
apply intervalIntegral.norm_integral_le_of_norm_le hτ.le _ (hg.intervalIntegrable _ _)
exact Filter.Eventually.of_forall (fun r hr => hbound r ⟨hr.1.le, hr.2⟩)
